tasks.title: The Power of Music
paras: Music has the remarkable ability to influence our emotions, behavior, and physical health. Studies show that listening to music can reduce stress, alleviate pain, and improve cognitive function. It is no surprise that music therapy has become an integral part of treatment for various conditions.

Music affects the brain by triggering the release of neurotransmitters such as dopamine and serotonin, which are associated with pleasure and mood regulation. Fast-paced music can energize us, while slower tempos can calm us down. This is why workout playlists often feature upbeat songs, while relaxation playlists include soothing melodies.

Beyond personal well-being, music also plays a crucial role in social interactions. It can strengthen bonds, create a sense of unity, and influence social movements. Chanting and singing have been used in protests and rallies to motivate and unify participants. Despite its benefits, not all music has a positive impact. Loud and aggressive music can sometimes increase stress and anxiety levels. Understanding the power of music and its effects can help us make informed choices about what we listen to and how we use it in our daily lives.

questions.stem: The word "alleviate" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：词汇题 原文定位：listening to music can reduce stress, alleviate pain, and improve cognitive function 解析：alleviate 意为缓解、减轻，与 reduce 并列近义。 选项分析： A. 拖延推迟，语义不符 B. 缓和减轻，词义完全匹配，正确 C. 监测管控，语境无关 D. 预测预估，含义不符

questions.stem: Why does the author mention neurotransmitters?

options.A: To provide some examples of chemicals in our bodies
options.B: To identify the mechanisms by which music influences pleasure and mood
options.C: To explain how music increases physical health
options.D: To imply that music affects social interactions

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：Music affects the brain by triggering the release of neurotransmitters such as dopamine and serotonin, which are associated with pleasure and mood regulation 解析：作者列举神经递质，用来解释音乐影响情绪、愉悦感的生理机制。 选项分析： A. 仅举例化学物质，并非段落表达目的 B. 说明音乐影响情绪与感受的内在原理，正确 C. 侧重身体健康，偏离本段情绪核心 D. 关联社交互动，话题完全不相关

questions.stem: The passage suggests that fast-paced music might be included in workout playlists for which of the following reasons?

options.A: It helps to calm down the listener.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：Fast-paced music can energize us, while slower tempos can calm us down 解析：快节奏音乐可以使人活力大增，因此适合运动场景。 选项分析： A. 舒缓情绪，是慢音乐作用，相反错误 B. 减轻压力，无原文依据 C. 使人精力充沛，完全对应原句，正确 D. 提升认知，不属于运动歌单选用原因

questions.stem: What does the passage mention as one way that music influences social interactions?

options.A: Music calms tense situations involving many people.
options.B: Music makes the bonds between people more powerful.
options.C: Music allows for a greater variety of social interactions.
options.D: Music can help stimulate more movement during large social gatherings.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：It can strengthen bonds, create a sense of unity 解析：音乐能够强化人际联结，增强群体凝聚力。 选项分析： A. 缓和紧张局面，文中无提及，无中生有 B. 使人际纽带更牢固，对应原文，正确 C. 丰富社交类型，过度延伸文意 D. 促进集体活动运动，原文未提及

questions.stem: Why does the author mention chanting and singing?

options.A: To illustrate how music is used in personal well-being
options.B: To highlight the role of music in social movements
options.C: To emphasize the negative impact of music
options.D: To discuss the effects of music on cognitive function

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：Chanting and singing have been used in protests and rallies to motivate and unify participants 解析：举例吟唱、合唱，突出音乐在社会运动中的凝聚与动员作用。 选项分析： A. 个人身心健康，不属于本段社交话题 B. 体现音乐在社会运动中的价值，正确 C. 强调音乐负面作用，与例子表意相反 D. 影响认知功能，话题完全偏离
